scope: Bounded primary-source and quantity-definition audit of seven existing EXAMPLE concentration inputs. No parameter, prior, tag, gate or runtime change.

provenance.method: Read frozen metadata and static source; primary full-text/abstract research; stdlib validation only. No cell/runtime imports or native simulations.
provenance.source_identity_match: Normalized exact DOI against frozen source_evidence, retaining all UIDs and original audit rows. Unregistered/failed identities remain ineligible even if primary text was read.

strongest_findings: MCF7 Kiuchi2011 100/10/200 µM are model assumptions; derived fractions are one conditional fit.
Funk2019 calibrated total actin/profilin requires an assumed half-cell accessible-volume denominator.
Packed-cell Arp2 and Arp3 subunit concentrations do not establish free cortical-shell Arp2/3 complexes.
Generic BNID and Pollard review reuse is a provenance trail, not independent primary evidence.
Code uses three different denominator conventions; the optional finite-buffer path is guarded off by frozen template switch0, while free G-actin also has a base-growth read.

measured_context.cell: Acanthamoeba; Dictyostelium; unactivated neutrophils and platelets; Xenopus egg extract; yeast
measured_context.assay: Review aggregation including personal communications; not one joint experiment
measured_context.denominator: Column-specific cellular/extract concentration; primary definitions differ

findings: Table 1 Acanthamoeba: G-actin 100, profilin 100, ADF/cofilin 20, Arp2/3 2–4, capping protein 1 µM.
Table 1 unactivated platelets: G-actin 220, thymosin-β4 550, ADF/cofilin 30, Arp2/3 9, capping protein 5 µM.
Table 1 unactivated neutrophils: G-actin 300, Arp2/3 10, capping protein 1–2 µM; Xenopus extract G-actin 12, profilin 5 and thymosin-β4 20 µM.
The inspected table does not establish universal profilin 20–100, thymosin 100–500, cofilin 10–40 or Arp2/3 1–2 µM uncertainty bands.
primary_cards.uncertainty: Ranges are table summaries, not SD/SEM/CI or a covariance matrix.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: A table across cell types cannot be promoted to one matched MCF7 parameter vector. Citation columns bundle several studies; not every cell has a one-to-one primary locator.
primary_cards.upstream_trace: Acanthamoeba table refs include Gordon1976 (G/F source not resolved here), Tseng1984, Cooper1986 and Kelleher1995; platelet column includes Hartwig personal communication. Repeated reuse is not independent support.

primary_cards.anchor: Results: Estimation of cellular concentrations; Fig. 3; Methods: Model fitting of s-FDAP data

measured_context.state: Serum-starved, unstimulated baseline for jasplakinolide model; NRG experiments are separate
measured_context.assay: Dronpa-actin sequential fluorescence decay after photoactivation, jasplakinolide perturbation; relative mobile-actin signal
measured_context.denominator: Model concentrations, not independently calibrated endogenous protein per measured aqueous volume

findings: G-actin total 100, profilin total 10 and thymosin-β4 total 200 µM are assumed inputs traced to Mogilner2002, not absolute measurements by this study.
Conditional model outputs: free G-actin 1.98, profilin-bound actin 9.52, thymosin-bound actin 88.5 µM; free profilin 0.48 and thymosin 111.5 µM.
Best-fit free barbed ends 4.8 nM and jasplakinolide Kd 120 nM; inferred pointed ends about 5.52 nM. Initial G-actin components sum to the imposed 100 µM.
Fig. 1 mobile Dronpa-actin fraction 79% is not the fraction of chemically free ATP-actin.
primary_cards.uncertainty: Fig. 3 time-course means±SEM, 13–21 cells across at least three experiments; confidence intervals on inferred concentrations not located. Time-curve SEM is not a concentration prior width.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: A shared MCF7 name does not convert model assumptions into absolute assays. Current profilin input 50 differs from this model input 10 µM; its derived free pool cannot be substituted into the current tuple.
derivation_assumptions: Unstimulated steady state and high ATP
Specified association/dissociation rates; barbed-end loss and pointed-end addition neglected
Bath jasplakinolide treated constant with rapid pointed-end inhibition
Initial molecular concentrations determined from best-fit B under the imposed totals/rates; do not count them as independently fitted observations
primary_cards.fit_parameter_distinction: The three actin concentrations are conditional derived initial values determined from fitted B and imposed total pools/rates; they are not three independently fitted parameters.

primary_cards.anchor: Fig. 1D; Methods: quantitative Western blotting and cell-volume determination

measured_context.cell: HT1080, B16F10, EL4, mouse BMDC and primary mouse neutrophils
measured_context.state: Cultured cell lines/primary preparations; not MCF7
measured_context.assay: Purified-protein-calibrated Western blots plus cell counting and fluorescence-exclusion whole-cell volume
measured_context.denominator: HALF measured whole-cell volume assumed accessible to soluble proteins

findings: HT1080 total actin 180±33 and PFN1 52±4 µM; B16F10 151±4 and 66±8; EL4 180±13 and 115±23.
BMDC total actin 192±12, PFN1 144±14 and PFN2 54±9 µM; neutrophils actin 196±35 and PFN1 111±18 µM.
These are total actin/profilin measurements. Profilin-actin concentration is subsequently inferred by near-saturation of profilin with actin.
The half-volume convention may overestimate concentrations by up to twofold if the entire measured volume is accessible, as the authors note.
primary_cards.uncertainty: Protein values mean±SD, N=3 independent experiments. Volume distribution is a separate sample: HT1080 2044±876 µm³, at least 300 cells/type. These do not provide matched per-cell covariance.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Total actin includes polymerized material and does not measure g_actin_total. Total PFN1 cannot by itself specify free profilin, profilin-actin, nucleotide state, or the MCF7 buffer pool.
derivation_assumptions: Profilin-actin estimate assumes abundant ATP soluble actin, rapid near-equilibrium binding and no sufficiently strong competing pool

measured_context.assay: Monomeric actin and thymosin measured; in-vitro 1:1 binding to platelet/muscle actin
measured_context.denominator: Cellular µM; original volume conversion not recovered

findings: Reported resting-platelet monomeric actin 280 µM and thymosin-β4 560 µM.
Platelet-actin binding Kd 0.4–0.7 µM; thymosin-actin 70–240 µM calculated using Kd 0.7 µM and assumed free-actin 0.1–0.5 µM.
primary_cards.uncertainty: No SD/SEM, replicate count or volume uncertainty identified in abstract. Kd/conditional complex ranges are not population SDs.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: The free-actin interval is a critical-concentration/capping assumption, not a direct intracellular free-actin measurement; resting platelet totals do not establish MCF7 values.

primary_cards.anchor: Results p. 323 and Discussion p. 327; Methods pp. 320–321

measured_context.assay: Western blot against chick ADF standard and silver-stained electrophoretic bands
measured_context.denominator: Percentage of total soluble protein; not directly µM in live accessible water

findings: Two immunoreactive species, 19 and 20 kDa. Western estimates 0.4% and 0.06% of soluble protein are minima because cross-reactivity is uncertain.
Silver staining instead gives about 0.4% and 1.3%; disagreement reflects assay/protein-identification limitations.
Discussion cites actin ~67 µM from prior work; the 60–85% monomer fraction refers to cold cell lysates.
primary_cards.uncertainty: Method-dependent estimates are not biological uncertainty intervals; sample-size/SD for a 20 µM cofilin estimate not found.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: This paper does not directly establish 20 µM human cofilin. Historical ADF/cofilin-family identity, phosphorylation, soluble fraction and mass-to-volume conversion require explicit resolution.

primary_cards.anchor: Quantitation of Arps p. 387; Results p. 392; fractionation/localization discussion

measured_context.assay: Quantitative immunoblotting with recombinant Arp standards, calibrated by Coomassie staining against actin
measured_context.denominator: Packed amoeba pellet; assumes 1 g pellet equals 1 mL

findings: Separate cellular concentrations: Arp2 1.9 µM and Arp3 5.1 µM. The paper reports Arp3 in excess of Arp2 and other complex subunits.
Cortical enrichment is localization evidence, not a calibrated cortical-shell aqueous concentration.
primary_cards.uncertainty: Numerical SD/CI and assay-specific n for the 1.9/5.1 estimates not located; fractionation replicate statements do not establish the n of concentration calibration.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Neither subunit concentration is automatically the concentration of intact, available Arp2/3 complexes. Current arp23.conc initializes a cortical-shell-water pool in static code; packed-cell average and shell concentration differ.

measured_context.assay: Cellular Arp2/3 concentration reported; full 1999 calibration method not recovered
measured_context.denominator: Cellular concentration; exact excluded-volume convention not verified

findings: Arp2/3 concentration 9.7 µM reported in human neutrophils.
primary_cards.uncertainty: No SD/SEM/n checked; one abstract point estimate.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Neither neutrophil state nor absolute compartment denominator matches the MCF7 cortical-shell free pool. A later WASp paper cannot substitute its volume assumptions for the 1999 Arp measurement.

primary_cards.anchor: Primary abstract: barbed-end capping, seed adsorption and immunoadsorption

measured_context.assay: High-speed lysate supernatant, submicromolar calcium, at least 100-fold cytoplasm dilution; spectrin-actin seed adsorption
measured_context.denominator: Estimated intact-cell concentration of free capper from lysate activity

findings: Available/free capper estimated at approximately 1–2 µM; the pool is functionally defined.
Removing more than 90% CPβ2 removed about 90% activity; extensive gelsolin removal did not reduce activity.
primary_cards.uncertainty: The 1–2 interval is an activity-derived estimate, not a reported SD or transferable concentration prior.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Functional free capper must not be equated to the declared inventory without the preparation stage: the finite constructor initially stores available CP as FREE_C, then initial tip binding consumes part of that pool. Extraction/dilution, species, cell state, volume and bound/free accounting remain unresolved.

findings: Capping protein:actin molar ratio 1:150; about one-third CP in crude membrane fraction and two-thirds soluble.

primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: A ratio cannot establish 1 µM without a matched actin amount and volume; soluble CP is not necessarily unbound active capper.

measured_context.denominator: Fraction of profilin associated with monomeric actin

findings: Gel filtration gives approximately 60% bound and 40% free profilin; immunoadsorption 65% bound; cellular fluorescence estimates 74–89% bound.

primary_cards.anchor: Results and Methods: photoactivation, Tβ4 depletion and lamellipodial actin

measured_context.assay: PA-GFP-actin, G/F proxy imaging and perturbation
measured_context.denominator: Spatial flux/pool behavior, not an absolute molar concentration assay

findings: Cytosol-derived, Tβ4-dependent monomers supply the leading edge, while locally recycled lamellipodial monomers show a distinct dependence.
primary_cards.uncertainty: No concentration uncertainty extracted; identity audit OK does not change this limitation.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Supports keeping spatial and chemical pools distinct. It supplies no numeric MCF7 concentration, covariance or automatic joint equilibrium.

measured_context.assay: Quantifies G-actin-binding proteins, distinguishes phosphorylated/unphosphorylated ADF/cofilin
measured_context.denominator: Estimated average brain-cell concentration; heterogeneous tissue

findings: G-actin estimated 30–37 µM and Tβ4 50–60 µM; free critical actin estimated about 0.45 µM on day 13 and 0.2 µM on day 17.
Unphosphorylated soluble ADF:Tβ4 ratio shifts from 1:7 to 1:4; developmental conditions are separate observations.
primary_cards.uncertainty: Full calibration, volume conversion, n and SD not verified. No covariance constructed from the reported ranges.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Useful precedent for measuring related pools in matched samples, not a mammalian prior. Free concentrations are derived, and age/tissue ranges do not define uncertainty for a single cell state.

measured_context.denominator: mg actophorin per gram cells; actin:actophorin ratio

findings: Actophorin 0.4±0.1 mg/g cells; actin:actophorin about 10:1.
primary_cards.uncertainty: The abstract does not identify whether ±0.1 is SD, SEM or another uncertainty; n not recovered.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Actophorin is not automatically human CFL1; conversion to molar concentration requires molecular mass, cell/pellet density and an explicit accessible volume. No such replacement is proposed.

reference_registry.retrieval_scope: Primary full text and frozen KB SE514 identity audit

source_evidence_records.notes:
Two molecularly distinct G-actin pools feed lamellipodia: a cytosolic thymosin-beta4-bound monomer pool targeted to formins/leading edge (elevated G/F ratio for protrusion) and a locally recycled lamellipodial F-actin pool.

Relevance: Establishes non-homogeneous monomer pools + spatial targeting constraining the transport-limited actin-resupply model. Caveat: seed mis-placed it in PNAS; it is Cell Reports.

code_anchors.meaning: Separate soluble actin/P/T/CP inventories. ATP free and P/T-bound actin initialized; P/T inputs are buffer totals, CP enters free_cap; polymer inventory is explicitly separate.
Auxiliary activity solves sum(B_i*a/(Kd_i+a))=total-free with finite buffers. This activity need not equal separately imposed free concentration; code explicitly denies an equilibrium claim.
Cofilin concentration times pool volume times cytosolic-water fraction creates a finite molecule budget and decoration ceiling; does not identify chemically free/active cofilin in an assay.
Arp2/3 initial free count uses cortical-shell accessible water; activity factor is total water/shell water. This is a static formula, not evidence of current runtime consumption.
Growth pool V_geom=membrane.volume0−envelope.volume0; conc_unit=1/(602.214×V_geom), without water fraction. g_actin_free feeds base growth concentration. Optional unit chemistry is gated at line977.
Chemical bath uses V_geom×water_fraction; its Arp shell argument uses cortex_shell_volume×water_fraction.
Cortex thin-shell geometry uses 4πr_shell²h, with r_shell derived from cell radius, gap and half thickness.
